messages:
Devon (Employee): Hi team 14B8 I've handed in my resignation, last working day will be 2026-05-15. Wanted to kick off logistics 4E64DD
Maya (People Ops): Thanks for the heads up, Devon. We'll coordinate offboarding tasks: benefits/COBRA eligibility, final pay, equipment, access removal, and exit interview.
Lee (Manager): Sorry to see you go, Devon. Can you share a 3-day ramp-down plan by EOD? Need to ensure coverage for the nightly job and client sync on 5/14.
Devon (Employee): Yep, will post plan in Confluence by EOD: https://confluence.redwood/devon-offboard-plan. Also can run a handoff session 5/14 10:30am PT.
Sam (IT): Noted. Question: will you drop off the MacBook at the SF office or ship it? Office drop-off preferred Wed-Fri. If shipping, we can schedule UPS pickup.
Devon (Employee): I'll be in SF on 5/16 and can drop off in person, but prefer company pick-up earlier if possible (to be safe).
Maya (People Ops): For benefits: you're full-time and enrolled in medical/dental. COBRA info: benefits end last day of employment; COBRA enrollment window 60 days after termination. We'll send the packet within 7 business days. Carmen will confirm any security hold on benefit docs.
Carmen (Security): I'll flag any shared service accounts and run an access audit. Please list any service accounts or infra keys you manage.
Lee (Manager): Devon manages the svc-monitor account and has write access to repo: platform/cron-jobs and infra-alerting.
Sam (IT): Creating ticket IT-4689 to coordinate SSO revoke (Okta), Slack removal, and asset pickup. Proposed schedule: revoke SSO on 5/15 at 09:00 PT, rotate svc-monitor key at 09:15, remove Slack/Google access at 09:30. Approve?
Lee (Manager): Approved. Try to keep the revoke after the handoff 10:30 on 5/14 so Devon can finish async tasks. 
Sam (IT): Will adjust: deprovision 5/16 09:00 PT (after drop-off) if devon drops off; if pickup occurs earlier then we'll do 5/15 09:00.
Priya (Payroll): Final paycheck: last pay cycle cutoff is 5/20; final salary will be paid on the 5/25 run, prorated to 5/15. Any outstanding expenses must be submitted by 5/18 to be included. 401k: you can request rollover or leave funds; I'll DM instructions.
Devon (Employee): Thanks, Priya. I need rollover guidance. Also I still have an outstanding laptop docking station reimbursement. Submitted expense #4871.
Priya (Payroll): Expense 4871 shows pending; will include with final run if submitted receipts are complete. I'll follow up via email.
Carmen (Security): Note on keys: after deprovision we'll rotate any vault entries with keys referenced by Devon and rotate API tokens for monitoring. Example rotation command for infra team: ```bash
vault kv put secret/infra/svc-monitor password=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
```
Maya (People Ops): Exit interview preference? We do 30 minutes, can do 5/16 afternoon or 5/20 morning. Devon which works?
Devon (Employee): 5/16 afternoon after drop-off works.
hr-bot: Action: create offboarding checklist for devon, flag benefits (COBRA eligible = yes), assign IT-4689, schedule exit interview 5/16 15:00 PT.
Maya (People Ops): Quick checklist summary in thread: 1) Devon to publish 3-day ramp plan (by EOD) 2) Knowledge handoff session 5/14 10:30 3) Asset pickup or drop-off (target 5/16) 4) SSO/Slack revoke & key rotation (target 5/16 09:00 if drop-off; otherwise 5/15 09:00) 5) COBRA packet sent within 7 business days 6) Final pay on 5/25, expenses by 5/18 7) Exit interview 5/16 15:00 PT.
Sam (IT): IT-4689 created. I'll update this thread when assets are collected and access removed.
Carmen (Security): I'll attach the 30-day access audit to the ticket and confirm no high-risk activity.
Lee (Manager): Thanks all. Devon, appreciate the handoff 49A. Ping me if anything changes.
Devon (Employee): Thanks team 44D
Maya (People Ops): I'll send the formal offboarding email and the COBRA packet link once HR mails it. Closing the loop here soon.
